I reviewed `359fb9d1a...HEAD` (8 commits, 11 files, 3 of them snapshots) in `--review-pr` mode and worked through all 67 rules in the checklist. I found 6 problems: 1 will break the build, 1 skips a lint check and 4 are convention issues. I didn't change any tracked files. The only file written is the checklist, `docs/engineering/pr-self-review-checklist.generated.md`, which is under the untracked `docs/engineering/` and isn't meant to be committed. Per your instructions, I didn't run any tests, so finding 1 comes from reading the code and the updated snapshot.

**Rules that applied:** TEST-01, TEST-02, TEST-04, UI-01, CODE-02, FEAT-04, PROD-01, API-01. I didn't need to look up the review history behind any rule. The rest had nothing in this diff to check: no auth, RTK, transactions, chain, mobile, CI, data merges or e2e changes.

## Findings

### 1. The new test contradicts the code it tests, so it will fail (TEST-01)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SecurityHub/components/SecurityReportDrawer/SecurityReportDrawer.test.tsx:16`
- The test expects the class `dark:bg-card`.
- But `surface="muted"` actually sets `dark:bg-[var(--color-background-main)]` (`apps/web/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx:72`). The last commit, d9b7f01a9, changed that class, and the updated `SecurityReportDrawer.stories.test.tsx.snap` confirms there's no `dark:bg-card` on the element.
- The test name at `:10` says "#fafafa surface … not white bg-card", which no longer matches either.
- **Fix:** assert `dark:bg-[var(--color-background-main)]` (or whatever token finding 3 settles on) and update the test name.

### 2. The grade colours now skip the Badge lint check (UI-01)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SecurityHub/components/SafeGradeChip/SafeGradeChip.tsx:15`
- Before, the one `needs_attention` override was written inline inside `className` with an explicit `eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax -- <reason>`.
- Now all four grades use raw `bg-[var(--color-*-background)] text-[var(--color-*-main)]` classes, stored in the module-level `GRADE_PILL_STYLES`. The lint rule (`apps/web/eslint.config.mjs`, around line 57) only catches class strings written directly inside the `className` attribute. Moving them into a constant means lint no longer sees them, so the disable comment disappeared without anyone deciding to allow this.
- The Badge now falls back to its `default` variant (`bg-primary text-primary-foreground`) and relies on tailwind-merge to override it. The snapshots now show `data-variant="default"` and a leftover `[a]:hover:bg-primary/80`.
- `badge.tsx` warns that `*-main` text on its matching tint fails the minimum contrast standard (WCAG AA) for some colours.
- **Fix:** use or add proper Badge variants (`negative`, `warning`, `positive`, plus a new `review` one). If raw colours are truly needed, keep the escape-hatch comment where the classes are used.

### 3. The new `muted` sheet surface uses a hard-coded colour instead of the existing token (UI-01)
`apps/web/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx:72`
- The line is `muted: 'bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[var(--color-background-main)]'`.
- `bg-zinc-50` is a raw Tailwind colour (#fafafa), not a theme colour, and it's used nowhere else in `src`.
- The light and dark halves also use different sources.
- A token for this already exists: `--surface-sunken` (`shadcn.css:40`), which `Card` uses as `surface="sunken"` → `bg-surface-sunken` (`card.tsx:58`).
- **Fix:** use `bg-surface-sunken`, or add a real theme token, and name the variant `sunken` to match Card.

### 4. Shared UI primitive edited without the required coordination note (FEAT-04)
`apps/web/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx:38`, `:71-72`
- This change touches `apps/web/src/components/ui/*`, so FEAT-04 applies. It requires the PR to either mention coordination with the in-flight design-system rewrite, or state that no such PR is open. Neither is here.
- `card.tsx` also keeps a dated `Changelog:` in its header comment, and this new variant isn't recorded in `sheet.tsx`.

### 5. One-off heading size overrides the typography scale (UI-01 / CODE-02)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SecurityHub/index.tsx:37`
- `<Typography variant="h1" className="mb-1 text-[32px] leading-9">` replaces the h1 size (48px) with custom values that aren't on the scale.
- **Fix:** use `variant="h2"` (30px), or add a variant if 32px is the intended design.
- **Product note (PROD-01):** this commit also renames "Security" to "Security hub" and removes the subtitle. The PR should say this came from a design decision.

### 6. Minor tidy-ups
- **Stray blank line:** `SafeGradeChip.tsx:65` has a blank line inside the `cn(...)` argument list.
- **Snapshot header changed:** the first line of `SafeGradeChip.stories.test.tsx.snap:1` went from `https://jestjs.io/docs/snapshot-testing` to `https://goo.gl/fbAQLP`. That suggests the snapshots were regenerated with a different Jest version than the repo uses, so they'll flip back on the next update.
- **Card styles written by hand (CODE-02):** `SectionPanel.tsx:30` gives each row `overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-card`. The `Card` component already provides these through its props; this is optional.

## Checked and fine
- **Nothing lost when code was removed (TEST-04, API-01):** removing `GRADE_BADGE_VARIANT`, `Separator` and the `Security` subtitle doesn't break any exported names or other code that uses them.
- **Scroll area:** `SCROLL_AREA` already exists in `@/utils/styles`, so reusing it is correct.
- **Hover colour:** `hover:bg-secondary-hover` maps to a defined theme token.
